title: Open the registration form from the login page and go back
preconditions: The test user is not logged in.
step: Open the login page.
expected: The login page should be shown.

step: Use the link on the login page that leads to the registration form.
expected: The registration form should be shown.

step: Click the link ‹expected: Already a customer? [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC1]›.
expected: The login page should be shown again.

title: Registration form has all five fields
preconditions: The test user is not logged in.
step: Open the registration form from the login page.
expected: The form should show the fields ‹expected: Email [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC2]›, ‹expected: Password [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC2]›, ‹expected: Repeat Password [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC2]›, ‹expected: Security question [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC2]› and ‹expected: Answer [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC2]›.

title: Empty email shows an error on leaving the field
step: Click into the Email field, leave it empty, then click into the Password field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Please provide an email address. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC4]› should be shown for the Email field.

title: Invalid email format shows an error on leaving the field
step: Type `reconqa-invalid` (no `@`) into the Email field, then click into the Password field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Email address is not valid. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC3]› should be shown for the Email field.

step: Replace the email with `reconqa-<random>@example.test`, then click into the Password field.
expected: The message should disappear.

title: Empty password shows an error on leaving the field
step: Click into the Password field, leave it empty, then click into the Repeat Password field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Please provide a password [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC4]› should be shown for the Password field.

title: Password with 7 characters is rejected
step: Type `Abcde-1` (7 characters) into the Password field, then click into the Repeat Password field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Password must be 8 to 40 characters. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC5]› should be shown for the Password field.

title: Password with 8 characters is accepted
step: Type `Abcde-12` (8 characters) into the Password field, then click into the Repeat Password field.
expected: No password length message should be shown.

title: Password with 40 characters is accepted
step: Type `Abcdefghij-Abcdefghij-Abcdefghij-12345` (40 characters) into the Password field, then click into the Repeat Password field.
expected: No password length message should be shown.

title: Different repeated password shows an error
step: Type `Reconqa-Pass1` into the Password field and `Reconqa-Pass2` into the Repeat Password field, then click into the Email field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Passwords do not match [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC6]› should be shown under the Repeat Password field.

title: Empty repeated password shows an error
step: Type `Reconqa-Pass1` into the Password field. Click into the Repeat Password field, leave it empty, then click into the Email field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Please repeat your password. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC6]› should be shown for the Repeat Password field.

title: Show password tips switch
step: Turn on the switch ‹expected: Show password tips [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC7]›.
expected: Advice on strong passwords should be shown.

step: Turn the switch off.
expected: The advice should be hidden.

title: No security question chosen shows an error
step: Open the Security question field and close it without choosing an entry, then click into the Answer field.
expected: The message ‹expected: Please choose a security question. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC8]› should be shown.

title: Warning that the security question cannot be changed
step: Look at the security question part of the form.
expected: The form should say ‹expected: This cannot be changed later! [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC8]›.

title: Registration without accepting the terms is not possible
preconditions: The registration form is open. Use a fresh email `reconqa-<random>@example.test`.
step: Fill Email, Password and Repeat Password with valid values (`Reconqa-Pass1`), choose any security question and type `reconqa` into the Answer field. Leave ‹expected: I accept the terms and conditions [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC9]› unticked.
expected: The form should be filled and the box should be unticked.

step: Try to send the form with ‹expected: Create account [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC10]›.
expected: The account should not be created and the login page should not show a success message.

step: Log in on the login page with the same email and password.
expected: The login should fail because no account exists.

title: Register a new customer
preconditions: The registration form is open. Use a fresh email `reconqa-<random>@example.test`.
step: Fill Email, Password and Repeat Password (`Reconqa-Pass1`), choose any security question, type `reconqa` into the Answer field and tick ‹expected: I accept the terms and conditions [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC9]›.
expected: No error messages should be shown.

step: Click ‹expected: Create account [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC10]›.
expected: The login page should be shown with the message ‹expected: Registration successful. Please log in. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC12]›.

title: Log in with the newly registered account
preconditions: The registration form is open. Use a fresh email `reconqa-<random>@example.test`.
step: Register the account with password `Reconqa-Pass1`, any security question, answer `reconqa` and the terms ticked.
expected: The login page should be shown with the message ‹expected: Registration successful. Please log in. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC12]›.

step: Log in with the same email and password.
expected: The login should succeed.

title: Email that already has an account is rejected
preconditions: The test user is not logged in. Use a fresh email `reconqa-<random>@example.test`.
step: Register the email with password `Reconqa-Pass1`, any security question, answer `reconqa` and the terms ticked.
expected: The login page should be shown with a success message.

step: Open the registration form again and fill it with the same email and valid values, terms ticked.
expected: No error messages should be shown yet.

step: Click ‹expected: Create account [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC10]›.
expected: The message ‹expected: Email must be unique. [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC11]› should be shown.

step: Check where the app is after the click.
expected: The registration form should still be shown and no second account should be created.

title: Sign up with Google is offered
step: Look at the buttons on the registration form.
expected: The buttons ‹expected: Create account [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC10]› and ‹expected: Sign up with Google [src: ticket:tickets/registration-spec.md#AC10]› should be shown.
